parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no structural evidence whatsoever: members is an empty array, and all structural_evidence fields (differing_slots, jaccard, shared_ancestor, shared_field_count) are null. Without any field lists, method signatures, or overlap metrics to reason about, there is no grounded basis on which to recommend a refactor between MetalWallpaperView and MetalWallpaperRenderer. The two types also appear to represent distinct responsibilities by name — a view and a renderer — whose co-location in the same Renderers/ directory is expected and intentional in a Metal-based rendering pipeline.
